floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 2 re-confirmed and diff reduced to ONE adjacent-pair swap (move t1,v1 <-> move a1,zero); real-loop family and a1-first-textual family both killed with mechanisms

frontier.hypothesis: The pass that lifted a1 in the old form (7th->5th) has a priority rule that can be steered to lift move a1,zero past move t1,v1 in form C without touching RA
frontier.mechanism: Old sched.c (GCC 2.7.2) block scheduling; a1=0's in-block consumer is the rotated loop head sll v0,a1,2 at block end, giving it nonzero forward priority; if the lift is sched2 (post-RA) it cannot regress the allocation
frontier.next_probe: Standalone repro of old form vs form C; cc1 -da; diff .greg/.sched/.sched2 dumps to identify the moving pass and its priority/tie-break rule; derive C-visible dependence tweaks from it

frontier.hypothesis: Some t1-set spelling tolerates the a1<->t1 conflict so a1=0 can be textually first with correct RA
frontier.mechanism: The 19-regression is one specific allocator tie flip; changing t1's pseudo nrefs/class/birth may re-flip it while keeping the conflict
frontier.next_probe: Grid over t1 provenance/typing and middle-group orderings (a1=0; t4; t3; t2; t1=val; mode; t0 etc.) in the no-init form, sandbox each; known dead: s32 t1 (4), mem-reload t1 (23), fresh counter (19)

frontier.hypothesis: Directed permuter from form C finds the legal C89 preamble spelling that flips the adjacent pair
frontier.mechanism: Search space is now a single transposition; PERM_* mutations over the seven preamble statements + decl styles
frontier.next_probe: permuter_campaign.py seeded from candidate.c restricted to the preamble; wait/harvest/stop in-turn per fresh-seed discipline
